relevance.rationale: Defines a twisted version of the Neumann-Zagier matrices of an ideal triangulation, establishes their symplectic properties, shows how to compute them from triangulation combinatorics, and uses them to define a twisted 1-loop invariant that determines the 1-loop invariant of cyclic covers and conjecturally equals the adjoint twisted Alexander polynomial. The corpus's NZ/1-loop machinery is active and recently corrected: computations/probes/borromean_nz_adjoint_torsion.py carries a 2026-08-07 correction retracting a wrong determinant construction, computations/one_loop_torsion.py is now the triangulation-invariant producer, and the multi-cusp overall constant is explicitly recorded as not pinned. Supporting rather than core because the corpus consumes the UNtwisted theory only: NZ matrices are already sourced to neumann-zagier1985 and the 1-loop invariant to dimofte-garoufalidis-2013, both cited, and nothing in the folio uses a twisted NZ matrix or a twisted Alexander polynomial. Its real value here is as a modern, self-contained account of the symplectic properties plus worked 4_1 numbers to check the corrected producer against.

keyResults.statement: Neumann-Zagier matrices and their twisted version, with the symplectic properties proved and an explicit recipe for computing them from the combinatorics of an ideal triangulation.
keyResults.useForFolio: A clean modern statement of the symplectic constraints the corpus's determinant must respect; relevant precisely because a wrong matrix was in production until 2026-08-07 and the corrected one still inherits an unpinned constant at c >= 2.

keyResults.statement: Fully worked NZ matrices and 1-loop invariant for the figure-eight knot.
keyResults.useForFolio: An independent published 4_1 value to regression-test computations/one_loop_torsion.py against, which matters because the corpus's 4_1 calibration was previously off by exactly a factor of two.

relevance.rationale: Defines a TWISTED version of the Neumann--Zagier matrices of an ideal triangulation, establishes their symplectic properties, and shows how to compute them from the combinatorics of the triangulation; as an application it defines a twisted one-loop invariant which determines the one-loop invariant of the cyclic covers of a hyperbolic knot complement and is conjecturally the adjoint twisted Alexander polynomial. The corpus depends on NZ matrices heavily and got one wrong. computations/probes/borromean_nz_adjoint_torsion.py carries a correction banner dated 2026-08-07 stating that its determinant is 'the WRONG construction', that its 4_1 calibration of sqrt(3) is exactly twice the correct value, and that its |det J_NZ(B_3)| = 64 'is not an invariant' because it varies under retriangulation and framing. The same arc's audit says the multi-cusp derivation 'is not in DG at all', i.e. the corpus went looking for literature covering its case and did not find this paper. A systematic treatment of NZ matrices computed directly from triangulation combinatorics is exactly what a construction that just failed retriangulation-invariance needs. One scoping limit must be respected and stated: the twisted one-loop invariant here is defined for ONE-CUSPED hyperbolic 3-manifolds. That covers the corpus's 4_1 calibration, which is where the factor-of-two error was found, but it does NOT cover the three-cusped Borromean complement, so this document must not be cited as settling the multi-cusp case. Corpus-grep run: no ref() entry for it (checked by author and by DOI stem; the neighbouring 2023 entry in the same journal is a different paper), and no audit or coordination ledger mentions twisted NZ matrices.

keyResults.locator: Abstract and the construction of twisted NZ matrices from triangulation combinatorics
keyResults.statement: Twisted Neumann--Zagier matrices are defined, shown to retain the symplectic properties of the untwisted ones, and computed directly from the combinatorics of an ideal triangulation.
keyResults.useForFolio: The reference construction against which the corpus's corrected NZ determinant should be checked, in a form that is explicitly combinatorial and therefore testable for the retriangulation invariance the corpus's earlier version failed.

keyResults.locator: Application: the twisted one-loop invariant (stated for one-cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds)
keyResults.statement: The twisted one-loop invariant is a topological invariant determining the one-loop invariant of the cyclic covers of a hyperbolic knot complement, conjecturally equal to the adjoint twisted Alexander polynomial.
keyResults.useForFolio: Directly relevant to the corpus's 4_1 one-loop calibration, which is one-cusped and is where the factor-of-two error was caught; explicitly NOT applicable to the three-cusped Borromean target, and any citation must say so.

proposedActions.rationale: The corpus's NZ-matrix arc was corrected one day before this triage and its audit states the multi-cusp case is absent from the literature it had; this paper is the systematic NZ-matrix treatment it lacks, and has no entry.

This is a verification of the corpus's own corrected value, not an adoption of an external one. Restrict strictly to the one-cusped case; do not extend the comparison to the Borromean complement.
